good_thing:
☀️ Good thing
(Oʻahu, Hawaiʻi): A newly weaned Hawaiian monk seal pup was safely moved from a riskier public beach to a remote shoreline. After a health check and ID tags, PO11, now called RV58, was released to grow up among wild seals while NOAA Fisheries continues to monitor her.
current_or_history:
📅 On this day
On August 20, 1977, Voyager 2 launched from Cape Canaveral. It became the first spacecraft to visit all four giant planets, carrying a Golden Record with greetings in 60 languages, music, and sounds from Earth.
tiny_fact:
🧠 Tiny fact
Octopuses have three hearts: two send oxygen-poor blood through the gills, and one pumps oxygenated blood around the body. Their blood appears blue because its oxygen-carrying molecule uses copper.
thought:
🌱 Thought for the day
You do not have to understand the whole sky to notice one good thing moving through it.
